notes.title: New Evo: Seacolt!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44632411/a7e910ac9bf50d226fddd7805a2a42ab7c353d55.jpg[/img]

[b]Attention, Duelists![/b] The winds of Bitacora Island have brought a fresh surprise to our shores—[b]a brand-new Evo, the majestic Seacolt, is here![/b]

From May 12 to May 19 at 10 AM PT, join us for the [b]Steam Creature Collector Fest[/b] and head to the fishing deck to catch this stunning new creature. Whether you're a seasoned collector or a new adventurer, this is your chance to add Seacolt to your roster and uncover its unique powers. Don’t miss out—dive in and play now for free!

[b]Note:[/b] We're working on Chapter 2, a major battle update, and controller support!
Stay tuned for upcoming updates and be sure to join our Discord community! [url=https://discord.gg/eqV5eaUXJq]https://discord.gg/eqV5eaUXJq[/url]

Have fun playing!
Your Duel Revolution Team

notes.title: Easter Event 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44632411/f780bc44631d65532df832a02abcd3268f5c7710.png[/img]

[b]Find all the Easter eggs[/b] and collect new Bunny Coins during this [b]two-week Easter event[/b]. Note that some items in the shop can be purchased with [b]Bunny Coins[/b], while others require Ether. 
Also check out [b]Jose's Fashion Shop[/b] in Millenia City! We have updated the shop, which now rotates [b]exclusive outfits[/b] from previous events weekly! 👗 
We hope you love the new outfits and enjoy this [b]Easter season[/b]!

[b]Thank you for playing![/b]
Your Duel Revolution Team

notes.title: Christmas Event
notes.content:
Our Christmas Event 2024 is here with 1 new Evo!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44632411/61277f4cd4db1b82f0f7c81cb6b616bb2cb6f10f.png[/img]

Say hello to Flocklio, a new icy Evo available for a limited time on Bitacora Island.

Enjoy lots of festive cheer with Christmas music and a cozy Christmas market in South Cliff.

Additionally, there are 3 new skill trees for Cheenut (CHE-777), Sinflos (SIN-X7Y), and Zipa (ZIP-7Y7), only available during the Christmas Event!

Have fun catching and collecting!
Your Duel Revolution Team

notes.title: Halloween Event
notes.content:
[b]Happy Halloween! Our Halloween Event 2024 is here with 2 new Evo![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44632411/eb0e1442e46f29368529215240445feea0dbbd6e.png[/img]
Join us in welcoming Skullpup and Ghirror, 2 Evo from the next island, who are now appearing here on Bitacora Island just in time for Halloween.

A new event shop also awaits you on Route 02 with fantastic Halloween costumes and a special candy-collecting quest.

[b]Additionally, there are 3 new skill trees for Raddip (RAD-ZX6), Baxo (BAX-XYZ), and Caniu (CAN-963)[/b], only available during the Halloween event!

Have fun catching and collecting. Happy Halloween!
Your Duel Revolution Team

notes.title: 🌞 Summer Event 2024
notes.content:
Our long-awaited summer event update is here, featuring an exciting new addition: 🎣 [b]Fishing![/b]

But that's not all. Here is a list of the new features in this update:
🐠 - Three new Evo to catch and train! Say hello to Razor, Sponk, and Hazy.
🌟 - Two new skill trees for the beloved Evo Shovly and Ravilar.
✨ - Five event shiny Evo for Razor, Sponk, Hazy, Shovly, and Ravilar. (Gens: SLS-669, SPO-339, HAZ-63Y, SHO-3X9, RAV-339) 
🌞 - During the summer, the shiny chance for event Evo is increased by 10 times, and on weekends, it's 50 times higher!
🛍️ - Summer Event Shop with new outfits available during the event. (More outfits and items will be added in the next days.)
🧪 - One new crafting recipe.
🎮 - New D-Pad movement option (changeable in settings).
🚫 - Player block functionality!
📋 - Menu improvements.
💖 - Donators Board where you can contribute to the game's development.
⚙️ - Stability and performance enhancements.

We hope you enjoy this update and the new fishing feature. Now, we will return to working on the next island. It will be our biggest update yet, continuing the story and introducing over 30 new Evos. Also, note that we will be adding new quests during the summertime for you to enjoy on Bitacora Island.

Thank you for playing, and keep dueling!

Your Duel Revolution Team

notes.title: New US & Asia Servers! + Numerous Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are excited to announce that our new servers in the US and Asia are now live, offering improved connectivity and stability. Additionally, many files previously required to be downloaded at the start are now pre-loaded directly into the build, streamlining your gaming experience.

Please take note of the following improvements from our last updates, which were not previously documented:
[list]
[*][b]Catch Rate Adjustment:[/b] Based on feedback, the initial catch rate was too challenging. It has been made easier, allowing for more successful catches with fewer attempts.[/*]
[*][b]Evocube Classic Price Reduction:[/b] The price for our primary catching device, the Evocube Classic, has been reduced from 250 to 150 Duel Coins.[/*]
[*][b]Evo Essence Reward:[/b] Releasing an Evo from the Storage menu now grants 1 Evo Essence.[/*]
[*][b]Evo Balancing:[/b] We've upgraded several Evos and nerfed some overpowered ones.[/*]
[*][b]Crash Report System:[/b] A new system for reporting game errors has been implemented, allowing us to quickly identify and rectify issues.[/*]
[*][b]Other Fixes:[/b] Various bugs have been addressed, including random crashes.[/*]
[/list]

Thank you for your support and feedback which help us improve the game continuously. Enjoy the enhanced gameplay and keep dueling!
